%: a page that fires at a display's
% \postdisplaypenalty is built only after the optional space after $$ is
% scanned (TeX 1200), so page 4 line 1 starts at h=0 as in MiKTeX.
\hyphenpenalty=10000 \hsize=4in \vsize=1.15in \predisplaypenalty=0
